latest_release.name: v0.3.2
latest_release.body:
OpenFilm 0.3.2 improves project switching on Windows, brings more of the edit across to other editors, and makes the canvas and asset library work together.

**Projects and workspace.** Open and switch project tabs more reliably on Windows. Duplicate a project from its menu, or reference media on a network share that disallows system links. The chat divider resizes the workspace and asset drawer together, and the inspector scrolls with a trackpad.

**Canvas and timeline.** Canvas writing nodes take text, image and video references. Videos rest on their opening frame, play on hover and can give you a still. Show in Assets finds the matching file and briefly highlights it. Organize compatible tracks with undo, select ranges of layers, and see mixed audio waveforms on compound clips.

**Editing-project exports.** Exports keep effects and visible subtitles automatically. Reference the original files or copy complete sources. Jianying and CapCut retain subtitle styling, and supported Jianying clip settings stay editable.

**Assets and services.** Large projects load visible thumbnails first. Library previews can be retried, and a paused viewer redraws when its images finish loading. Canvas model choices update as soon as a service connects. TBC mischief 1 and Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite are available with your OpenRouter key.

Check for updates in the desktop app or use the installers below. CLI users can run `npm i -g openfilm`.

Thanks to @yunloong-Y and @WEBGRS for their pull requests in this release.

### Patch Changes

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Bring the destination project forward when switching tabs or opening a project from the plus button on Windows. The Projects menu can duplicate the current edit into an independent project in the same group.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Reference original files and folders on Windows network shares that refuse system links. The references work for previews and exports.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Refresh open timelines after changes outside the editor, retry failed reads, and keep newer edits when an older response arrives late. The canvas and edit retain separate panel sizes.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Keep the asset drawer and workspace aligned when dragging the chat divider. Constrain the inspector so the properties scroll while the tabs stay in place.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Add text, pictures and videos as writing-node references. Canvas videos show the first frame at rest, play on hover, and can be renamed or captured as stills. Imported nodes register their connection handles as soon as the upload finishes.

- [#433](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/433) [`758b1a3`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/758b1a3888819bf191db191f690c4ca2fcb292af) Thanks [@riverisbuilding](https://github.com/riverisbuilding)! - Refresh canvas generation models when media settings change or a browser sign-in completes. Show in Assets scrolls to the matching card and briefly highlights it.

detail.readme:
The open source AI video agent.

One HTML file, one function, one real editor.

English · 简体中文

## About OpenFilm lets your coding agent make videos, and lets you edit them. Ask Codex, Claude Code or any coding agent to make a film. It writes the film as web pages, and Studio, a local editor that runs in your browser, shows it taking shape. Then change anything you like, by hand or by asking. - **One HTML file.** `film.html` cuts animated web pages, footage, pictures and sound together on tracks, styled with CSS. Nothing new to learn: your agent already knows the web. - **One function.** Each shot is a web page that draws any moment with `frame(t)`, using anything a browser can draw: three.js, WebGL, canvas, SVG, CSS, GSAP, video and more. No framework (like Remotion or HyperFrames): one function is enough. - **One real editor.** Move, scale and rotate any element inside a page, change its text, color and style; place, crop and restyle every clip, trim and cut them on the timeline.


▶ Watch the 1:42 launch video, made with OpenFilm from start to finish.

## Install Requires Node 22.2+ and ffmpeg, on macOS, Windows or Linux (git too, for Studio's saved versions); the first run downloads a headless Chromium (about 100 MB). ```sh npx skills add openfilm/openfilm ``` Then ask your agent for a film: > Make a 20-second launch video for my CLI, with music. It opens the film in Studio and you watch it take shape. If your agent has no skills, tell it: "Run `npx -y openfilm@latest` and follow what it prints." Or download the desktop app for macOS or Windows from [openfilm.dev](https://openfilm.dev) or [Releases](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/releases): Studio with a chat beside it for the agents you have. It comes with ffmpeg and the headless browser, so there is nothing else to install. Making, editing and rendering films needs no account, and OpenFilm's library of music, sounds, voices, stickers, transitions, effects and templates is free to use. For generated voice, music, images and video, connect the services you use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, fal and others) with your own keys in Studio's Settings → Services, or sign in to OpenFilm there to make them without keys of your own. To start from a finished film, open one of the [examples](https://github.com/openfilm/examples): ```sh npx -y openfilm@latest open https://github.com/openfilm/examples/tree/main/one-prompt ``` ## Commands Your agent runs them; so can you, with `npx -y openfilm@latest ` or `npm i -g openfilm`. ```sh openfilm # what a film is, and OpenFilm's own skills: where an agent starts openfilm open [folder | url] # show a film in Studio: a new one, an existing one, one from GitHub, else this one or the last openfilm look [what] [t | a-b] # check the film, a page or a media file: a contact sheet, one frame, or a range openfilm render [a-b] # the MP4; --4k, --blur (motion blur), --alpha (.webm / .mov), --loudness=-14 openfilm get [what] # media: free from OpenFilm's library first, else made by a connected service openfilm canvas [apply ] # the canvas beside the edit: read it, or lay out notes, files and what to make openfilm skills # the skills a film can be made with; `openfilm skill ` prints one openfilm doctor # what this computer has for OpenFilm, to paste into an issue ``` `openfilm --help` lists a command's options; `openfilm get` alone lists what can be made, what the library has, and how to connect a service in Studio. ## Studio Studio runs on your machine, in your browser: use one built on Chromium (Chrome, Edge), the engine films are drawn and exported with, so the preview is what you export. Everything in the film can be changed: text and layers in the picture, clips on the timeline, their place, look, volume and speed, and the subtitles. Your edits are saved to the film's files, so the agent sees and keeps them, and you can save named versions to go back to. Export a video, a GIF, the sound or its stems, subtitles, stills, slides, a transparent video, or the timeline itself for Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. Beside the edit is the canvas (⌘E switches between them): a board where you and the agent lay out notes, pictures, clips, voice-over, music and sound, wire them into each other, make each with your services, and send what you made to the timeline in order. A project can have several, each also seen as a storyboard. The library, in the assets drawer, holds footage, voices, sounds, music, text, stickers, filters, effects, transitions and templates, and the skills. The desktop app ([apps/desktop](apps/desktop)) is Studio with a chat beside it, for Claude Code, Codex and the other agents, or its own agent with your own key. ## Skills How a film is made lives in skills, not in the tool. `openfilm` prints one page: what a film is, and OpenFilm's own skills, which hold the rest: `edit` (the project, film.html and pages, and checking them), `media` (the library and the services) and `canvas`. An agent reads the one a task needs with `openfilm skill `. Every other skill is a way of making a kind of film, known by its full name, `owner/name`. Studio's library lists OpenFilm's and the community's under Discover, from [openfilm/skills](https://github.com/openfilm/skills), which also says how to write one; install one there, try it in a conversation without installing it, or add your own from a link or a folder (`openfilm skill add `). An installed skill is offered to every agent. ## How it works A film is a folder with a `film.html`: tracks of clips cut together. ```html
``` Each `
` is a track, in the order the timeline shows them: the first on top. A clip is an element: a page, a video, a still picture or a sound. Which part of its file plays is a media fragment (`#t=12,18`), where it starts is `at`, where it sits is its style's `left`, `top`, `width` and `height`, and how it looks is CSS. Every sound is a clip of its own. `overrides` hold your changes to elements of a page, and agents keep them when they edit. A page is a web page that draws any moment of itself, and that is the whole contract: ```html ``` **The one rule:** the same `t` always draws the same picture, whatever was drawn before. Frames are asked for out of order, in parallel and between frames (for motion blur), so a page that keeps the rule renders the same at any size, on any machine. Anything else that makes pictures (Python, Blender, a video model) comes in as video or images. OpenFilm spends its effort where models fail: checking the film. `look` draws every frame of its sheet twice, in two shuffled orders, and names any that changed, along with page errors, fonts that failed to load, missing sound files, and text cut off by the frame. [MANUAL.md](packages/openfilm/MANUAL.md) is the page `openfilm` prints, and [packages/openfilm/manual](packages/openfilm/manual) holds OpenFilm's own skills; [SPEC.md](packages/openfilm/SPEC.md) is for anyone building a player, renderer or editor. ## From source You need Node 22.18 or later, pnpm 9 (`corepack enable` gives you the version this repository names), ffmpeg on the PATH, and git. ```sh git clone https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm && cd openfilm pnpm install pnpm dev # Studio from this checkout, with a sample film, beside an installed OpenFilm pnpm test ``` Tell your coding agent to run `packages/openfilm/.dev/bin/openfilm` and it makes films with your checkout, in that Studio. Every OpenFilm, installed or from source, keeps its projects in the same library. `pnpm dev:desktop` runs the desktop app from source, and `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build` and `pnpm audit:public` do what they say. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) has the details of each package. ## Community Questions, ideas and films you made go to [Discussions](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/discussions): ask in Q&A, share your film in Show and tell. Bugs go to [Issues](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/issues), with the report from Studio's Settings → Developer → Copy report (or `npx openfilm doctor`). ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). To report a security issue, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## License The format, the CLI, Studio and the desktop app are [MIT](LICENSE). The OpenFilm name and logo are trademarks: see [TRADEMARK.md](TRADEMARK.md). ## Star History
detail.readme_zh:
开源的 AI 视频智能体。

一个 HTML 文件，一个函数，一个真正的剪辑器。

English · 简体中文

## 简介 OpenFilm 让你的编程智能体来做视频，也让你亲手修改。 让 Codex、Claude Code 或任何编程智能体做一部片子。它把片子写成网页，Studio（一个在浏览器里运行的本地剪辑器） 实时显示片子成形的过程。之后哪里想改就改，可以自己动手，也可以直接跟它说。 - **一个 HTML 文件。** `film.html` 把动画网页、视频素材、图片和声音按轨道剪在一起，样式用 CSS 写。不用学新东西： 你的智能体本来就懂网页。 - **一个函数。** 每个镜头都是一个网页，用 `frame(t)` 画出任意时刻，浏览器能画的都能用：three.js、WebGL、canvas、 SVG、CSS、GSAP、视频等等。不需要框架（比如 Remotion 或 HyperFrames）：一个函数就够了。 - **一个真正的剪辑器。** 可以移动、缩放、旋转页面里的任何元素，改它的文字、颜色和样式；摆放、裁剪、调整每个片段的 样式，在时间线上修剪和切分。


▶ 观看 1 分 42 秒的发布视频（英文），从头到尾都是用 OpenFilm 做的。

## 安装 需要 Node 22.2+ 和 ffmpeg，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux（Studio 保存版本还需要 git）；第一次运行会下载一个无界面的 Chromium（约 100 MB）。 ```sh npx skills add openfilm/openfilm ``` 然后让你的智能体做一部片子： > 给我的命令行工具做一支 20 秒的发布视频，带配乐。 它会在 Studio 里打开这部片子，你能看着它一步步成形。如果你的智能体不支持 skill，就对它说：“运行 `npx -y openfilm@latest`，按它打印的内容来做。” 也可以从 [openfilm.dev](https://openfilm.dev) 或 [Releases](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/releases) 下载 macOS 或 Windows 桌面版：就是 Studio，旁边多了一个对话窗口，接上你已有的智能体。它自带 ffmpeg 和无界面浏览器， 不用另外安装。 制作、剪辑和渲染片子都不需要账号，OpenFilm 素材库里的音乐、音效、音色、贴纸、转场、特效和模板都可以免费使用。需要生成 配音、音乐、图片和视频时，在 Studio 的设置 → 服务里，用你自己的 key 连接你在用的服务（ElevenLabs、OpenAI、Google、 OpenRouter、fal 等），或者登录 OpenFilm，不用自己的 key 也能生成。 想从一部完整的片子开始，可以打开一个[示例](https://github.com/openfilm/examples)： ```sh npx -y openfilm@latest open https://github.com/openfilm/examples/tree/main/one-prompt ``` ## 命令 这些命令由你的智能体来运行；你也可以自己运行：`npx -y openfilm@latest <命令>`，或者先 `npm i -g openfilm`。 ```sh openfilm # 片子是什么，以及 OpenFilm 自带的技能：智能体从这里开始 openfilm open [folder | url] # 在 Studio 里打开片子：新建、打开已有的、从 GitHub 获取，或者当前目录的、上次打开的 openfilm look [what] [t | a-b] # 检查片子、某个页面或媒体文件：缩略图总览、单帧或一段区间 openfilm render [a-b] # 渲染成 MP4；--4k、--blur（运动模糊）、--alpha（.webm / .mov）、--loudness=-14 openfilm get [what] # 素材：先从 OpenFilm 素材库免费取，没有再用你接入的服务生成 openfilm canvas [apply ] # 剪辑旁边的画布：读取，或者摆上笔记、文件和要生成的内容 openfilm skills # 可以用来做片子的技能；`openfilm skill <名字>` 打印其中一个 openfilm doctor # 这台电脑上 OpenFilm 需要的东西，可以直接贴进 issue ``` `openfilm <命令> --help` 列出某个命令的选项；单独运行 `openfilm get` 会列出能生成什么、素材库里有什么，以及怎么在 Studio 里接入服务。 ## Studio Studio 在你的电脑上运行，在浏览器里打开。片子里的一切都能改：画面里的文字和图层，时间线上的片段，它们的位置、外观、 音量和速度，还有字幕。你的修改会保存到片子的文件里，智能体能看到并保留它们；你也可以保存带名字的版本，随时回退。 可以导出视频、GIF、声音或分轨、字幕、静帧、幻灯片、透明背景视频，也可以把整条时间线导出给 Final Cut Pro、Premiere Pro 和 DaVinci Resolve。 剪辑旁边是画布（⌘E 在两者之间切换）：你和智能体可以在上面摆笔记、图片、视频、配音、音乐和音效，把它们连起来，用你的 服务逐个生成，再按顺序送到时间线。一个项目可以有多个画布，每个也能看成分镜。素材库在素材抽屉里，有视频素材、音色、音效、 音乐、文字、贴纸、滤镜、特效、转场、模板，还有技能。 桌面版（[apps/desktop](apps/desktop)）就是 Studio 加上一个对话窗口，可以用 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体，也可以用 它自带的智能体配上你自己的 key。 ## 技能 片子怎么做写在技能里，而不是写死在工具里。`openfilm` 只打印一页：片子是什么，以及 OpenFilm 自带的技能，其余的都在 这些技能里：`edit`（项目、film.html 和页面，以及怎么检查）、`media`（素材库和各项服务）、`canvas`（画布）。智能体 用 `openfilm skill <名字>` 读取当前任务需要的那个。 其他技能各是一种做片子的方法，用全名 `owner/name` 区分。Studio 素材库的「发现」里列出 OpenFilm 官方和社区的技能， 来自 [openfilm/skills](https://github.com/openfilm/skills)，那里也说明了怎么写一个技能。可以在那里安装，也可以不安装 直接在对话里试用，或者从链接、文件夹添加你自己的（`openfilm skill add <链接>`）。装好的技能所有智能体都能用。 ## 工作原理 一部片子就是一个带 `film.html` 的文件夹：由片段组成的轨道剪在一起。 ```html
``` 每个 `
` 是一条轨道，顺序和时间线上一致：第一条在最上层。一个片段就是一个元素：页面、视频、静态图片或声音。 播放文件的哪一段用媒体片段标记（`#t=12,18`），从什么时候开始用 `at`，放在哪里用样式里的 `left`、`top`、`width` 和 `height`，长什么样用 CSS。每个声音都是独立的片段。`overrides` 保存你对页面里元素的修改，智能体编辑时会保留它们。 一个页面就是一个能画出自己任意时刻的网页，这就是全部约定： ```html ``` **唯一的规则：** 同一个 `t` 永远画出同一个画面，不管之前画过什么。渲染时会乱序、并行地请求各帧，还会请求两帧之间的 时刻（用于运动模糊），所以遵守这条规则的页面，在任何尺寸、任何电脑上渲染出来都一样。其他能出画面的东西（Python、 Blender、视频生成模型）以视频或图片的形式接进来。 OpenFilm 把功夫花在模型容易出错的地方：检查片子。`look` 会把总览里的每一帧按两种打乱的顺序各画一遍，指出前后不一致 的帧，同时报告页面错误、加载失败的字体、缺失的声音文件，以及被画面边缘截断的文字。 [MANUAL.md](packages/openfilm/MANUAL.md) 是 `openfilm` 打印的那一页，[packages/openfilm/manual](packages/openfilm/manual) 里是 OpenFilm 自带的技能；[SPEC.md](packages/openfilm/SPEC.md) 是给想做播放器、渲染器或剪辑器的人看的格式规范。 ## 从源码运行 需要 Node 22.18 或更高版本、pnpm 9（`corepack enable` 会自动使用本仓库指定的版本）、PATH 里有 ffmpeg，以及 git。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm && cd openfilm pnpm install pnpm dev # 用这份源码运行 Studio，带一部示例片，和你安装的 OpenFilm 各用各的端口 pnpm test ``` 让你的编程智能体运行 `packages/openfilm/.dev/bin/openfilm`，它就会用这份源码在这个 Studio 里做片子。不管是安装的还是 源码运行的 OpenFilm，项目都在同一个项目库里。 `pnpm dev:desktop` 从源码运行桌面版；`pnpm typecheck`、`pnpm build` 和 `pnpm audit:public` 分别是类型检查、构建和 公开内容审计。各个包的详细说明见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)（英文）。 ## 社区 提问、想法和你做的片子，都欢迎发到 [Discussions](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/discussions)：问题发在 Q&A， 作品发在 Show and tell。发现 bug 请提 [Issue](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/issues)。 ## 参与贡献 见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)（英文）。报告安全问题见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 ## 许可证 格式、命令行工具、Studio 和桌面版均采用 [MIT](LICENSE) 许可证。OpenFilm 的名称和 Logo 是商标：见 [TRADEMARK.md](TRADEMARK.md)。 ## Star 趋势
